messages:
Ravi: Tiny brag — we just hit 120M requests across hosted last week. :confetti_ball: Couldn't have done it without you all.
Elena: WHAT!! Amazing. Donut cart or virtual donut drop for remote folks? :doughnut:
Sam: Donut cart please. Also can we get sprinkles on demand? 
ops-bot: FYI: maintenance window tomorrow 03:00-03:30 UTC. Won't affect today's celebration. :white_check_mark:
Ravi: @Elena ordering the cart now. Adding gluten-free and vegan options. Also small sticker packs for remote teams.
CEO-Jordan: Huge congrats team — incredible momentum. Id love to swing by for 15 mins and hear war stories. When's good?
Tess: If Jordan can make it, can we do the 3pm "open mic" on level 4? Short stories, max 3 minutes each.
Elena: 3pm works. Remote folks can drop a short clip in the channel or join the call.
Sam: I'll bring the tiny gong. (Yes it exists.)
Ravi: Also shoutout to night-shift oncall for catching the mem-leak early. @Sam you rock.
CEO-Jordan: Quick live Q&A after the open mic? 10 minutes. I want to hear what surprised you building this.
Tess: Added calendar invite: "120M quick huddle + donuts". Link to hangout in the event.
Elena: Remote team, expect a little snack box via courier by EOD. Post a selfie with your donut to get a sticker pack!
Sam: Countdown starts. See you in real life or pixel donuts. ":)"
